name: My views
description: A start page of your own: a greeting and the time, buttons that open a chat, a terminal or a browser, your workspaces and your PRs.

scopes.actions:run: Open a chat, a terminal, a browser or a PR from the page, and the page from the sidebar.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a workspace when you click it.
scopes.net:api.github.com: Read your PRs by your GitHub login when GitHub is not connected.
